General Context
Portal
Long-horizon intelligence.
We believe the next era of frontier data will come from products where people and agents solve real problems together. General Context builds the products and datasets to improve frontier models in the domains of software engineering, ML & AI research, and engineering & robotics.
We’re backed by Tier 1 VCs and angels from Anthropic, OpenAI, and SpaceXAI.
Our work
LongHorizonSWE 4–12 hour engineering tasks that require sustained implementation, debugging, and iteration. 3JSBench Benchmarking frontier models on 3D generation ability. v1 v46 Trajectories for human-agent collaboration Human-agent collaboration on long horizon coding tasks for game development.
